pages.title: Case Studies Archives | GoGloby
pages.summary: The case-study archive presents GoGloby as building AI systems and engineering tools, which conflicts with its approved staffing and recruiting positioning. Its performance figures and client outcome claims are not supported by the company sources and should not be carried into a rewrite without verification.

pages.title: AI Recruiting Agent in Slack: GoGloby Reduced Scheduling by 75%
pages.summary: The page presents GoGloby as an AI software builder and standalone SaaS provider, an offer that conflicts with its staffing and recruiting positioning. Its product metrics and client testimonials are also unsupported by the company sources, so decide whether to remove or substantially revise the case study before keeping it live.

pages.title: How GoGloby’s Applied AI Engineering Delivered Measurable ROI
pages.summary: The page promotes an Applied AI implementation and measurement offer rather than GoGloby’s approved staffing and recruiting services. The case-study results, client profile, security claims, and productivity claims also need verification before they are retained.

pages.title: A Semantic ML Pipeline: How GoGloby Cut Screening Time by 85%
pages.summary: The page presents GoGloby as building AI systems and selling applied AI engineering work, rather than as a staffing and recruiting agency. It also contains many company-specific results and technical claims that are not supported by the company sources; decide whether this case study and the offer it promotes should remain before editing it.

pages.title: A Nasdaq HealthTech Company Integrated a $3B Platform
pages.summary: The case study presents GoGloby as a broad engineering-team builder delivering generic engineering and compliance services, rather than as a specialist Data & AI staffing and recruiting agency. It also makes numerous unsupported claims about this engagement, its metrics, security arrangements, and client profile.

pages.title: A Real-Time Voice AI System: How GoGloby Cut Screening Costs
pages.summary: The page presents GoGloby as a company that builds and maintains custom voice AI systems, an offer that conflicts with its recruiting and staffing positioning. The case-study results, anonymous client claims, and related metrics are not supported by the company sources; decide whether to retain the page before correcting those claims.
